detail: v2 investigation begun. SPEC_V2.md is authoritative pre-registration; HYPOTHESIS.md cycle 2 written grounded in spec. Primary metric CQS-craft = 0.45*idiom + 0.45*comment + 0.10*(1-mean_rubric/5), all LLM-judge derived.

preamble_quality_v2_poc.py written: 1 model × 3 conditions (none/real_agent/python_coder_agent) × 2 tasks (lru_ttl_cache creation + modeflag_sort trap-refactor). Loads python-coder agent prompt at runtime. 0-5 severity rubric on 11 single-file dimensions. CQS-craft formula pre-registered.

PoC ran end-to-end: 6/6 valid generations, 17/18 successful judges. SURPRISE: python_coder_agent CQS-craft=0.63 vs real_agent=0.82 vs none=0.79. Lowest rubric severity (0.09) but lowest idiom/comment scores. Outputs ~25-35% shorter. Trap task NOT resisted by any condition.
README.md written: 5 intent-review flags surfaced for human review per Step 2 protocol. Awaiting decision before Step 3 (debate dispatch).

USER CORRECTION at Step 2 intent review: hypothesis was drifting toward 'is python_coder_agent better than synthetic preambles' instead of v1's 'preambles change craft quality vs none/neg_control.' python_coder_agent is one rich-preamble data point, not the primary contrast. Updating HYPOTHESIS.md (preserve original draft) and SPEC_V2.md §2 goals. Restart Step 1 framing; PoC code unchanged, interpretation revised.

HYPOTHESIS.md amended: preserved Cycle-2 initial draft as SUPERSEDED; added Cycle-2 Revised as ACTIVE. SPEC_V2.md §2 goals revised: primary contrast = rich-preamble vs none vs neg_control; python_coder_agent reframed as one rich-preamble data point, not a contrast tested for itself. README.md flags 1 and 5 reframed to match.
Step 2 intent review complete under corrected hypothesis. PoC pipeline validated end-to-end. Modes locked: conclusions_only + debate. Ready to dispatch ml-critic R1 (Step 3 Stage A.1).
Beginning Step 3 Stage A.1: dispatch ml-critic R1 on revised HYPOTHESIS.md + PoC. Debate mode, multi-round protocol per skill spec.

Dispatching ml-critic Mode 1 with HYPOTHESIS.md (Cycle-2 Revised active), preamble_quality_v2_poc.py, README.md. Cycle-2-initial draft section explicitly marked SUPERSEDED — critic must treat the Revised section as authoritative.

Critic R1 returned 7 findings. F1 (sev 9, FATAL): out-of-range judge scores enter CQS-craft unclamped — VERIFIED in PoC data (deepseek emitted -1 on python_coder_agent/modeflag_sort). F2 (sev 8, FATAL): trap task 'exact signature' clause defeats resistance probe. F3-F5 (sev 5-6, MATERIAL): rubric hygiene flooring, comment-quality vs preamble-conciseness confound, 9/11 rubric dims structurally inapplicable to algorithmic tasks. F6-F7 (sev 2-3, MINOR): judge calibration, length-confound sensitivity.

Dispatching ml-defender R1 (Mode 1) with 7 non-suppressed findings from critic R1. Note: F1 has been ORACLE-VERIFIED by the orchestrator (deepseek -1 sentinel found in PoC judge records); defender should not REBUT the empirical claim, only adjudicate severity/scope.

Defender R1: F1 CONCEDE (sev 9, fix=clamp); F2 DEFER (sev 8, prompt rewrite); F3 REBUT-DESIGN (sev 6->2); F4 DEFER (sev 6); F5 DEFER (sev 5); F6 REBUT-DESIGN (sev 3->1); F7 REBUT-SCOPE (sev 2->0). Overall: empirical_test_agreed.
Beginning Step 4 Stage B Round 1: ml-critic-r2 challenge against defender R1 rebuttals. min_rounds=2, max_rounds=4.

Critic-R2 R1: F1/F3/F7 ACCEPT; F2 PARTIAL sev 8→7 (signature in code block, not just 'exact' word); F4 PARTIAL sev 6→5; F5 PARTIAL sev 5 held; F6 PARTIAL sev 3→2. No early-exit; min_rounds not reached. Proceed to defender R2.

Defender R2 R1: F1 CONCEDE sev 9 (unchanged); F2 DEFER sev 7 (accepted critic reduction, tightened settling); F3 REBUT-DESIGN sev 2; F4 DEFER sev 5 (tightened); F5 DEFER sev 5; F6 REBUT-DESIGN sev 1 (rank-invariance argument, held below critic 2); F7 REBUT-SCOPE sev 0. Defender SELF-CORRECTED R1 verdict from empirical_test_agreed to critique_wins citing F1 CONCEDE at sev 9 mechanically triggering it.

Round 1 verdict: critique_wins (F1 CONCEDE sev 9, constitutional override). F2/F4/F5 → ETA. F3/F6/F7 → defense_wins. Not converged: min_rounds=2 not reached AND non-terminal findings remain. Proceed to round 2.
Beginning Stage B Round 2. prev_verdict=critique_wins.

Critic-R2 R2: F1/F3/F7 ACCEPT (unchanged); F6 PARTIAL→ACCEPT sev 1 (rank-invariance argument accepted); F2 PARTIAL sev 7→6 (rewrite execution risk); F4 PARTIAL sev 5→4 (judge-prompt amendment as pre-reg drift); F5 PARTIAL sev 5 held (no specified action if pilot audit fails).

Defender R2 R2: F1 sev 9 (CONCEDE held); F2 sev 7→6 with empirical gate (rewrite must pass ≥5-sample pilot showing ≥40% no-preamble mode_flag rate); F4 sev 5→4 with pre-reg amendment commitment; F5 sev 5 with branching recovery path; F3/F6/F7 unchanged. Overall: critique_wins (F1 dominant).
Round 2 verdict: critique_wins (F1 CONCEDE sev 9 dominant). F2/F4/F5 → ETA. F3/F6/F7 → defense_wins. Convergence check: F2 (7→6) and F4 (5→4) moved → not strictly converged. Continue to round 3.
Beginning Stage B Round 3. Expectation: critic ACCEPTs all (defender commitments tightened to concrete gates/recovery paths) → B.1 early-exit.

Critic-R2 R3: 6 ACCEPT + 1 PARTIAL. F2 ACCEPT sev 6→3 (gate closes mechanism); F5 ACCEPT sev 5→2 (branching recovery complete); F4 PARTIAL sev 4→3 (probe design doesn't target style-directive confound); F1/F3/F6/F7 unchanged. Not B.1 early-exit (1 PARTIAL); proceed to defender R2 R3.

Defender R2 R3: F4 switched DEFER→CONCEDE at sev 3 (calibration probe can't surface style-directive confound; DEFER question 4 fails on asymmetric mechanism). Committed concrete empirical probe-extension: 10+ python_coder_agent outputs scored with anchored/unanchored variants pre-main-run. F1/F3/F5/F6/F7 unchanged; F2 carried at sev 3.
Round 3 verdict: critique_wins (F1 CONCEDE sev 9). F2-F7 all defense_wins (adj_sev ≤ 3).

Debate converged after 3 rounds: stop_reason=fully_resolved (all findings at terminal states — F1 critique_wins, F2-F7 defense_wins). Verdict stable critique_wins driven solely by F1 CONCEDE sev 9. No min_rounds guard needed.
Beginning Step 5 Gate 1: construct pre-flight checklist + experiment plan from debate verdicts.

Gate 1 pre-flight checklist constructed: 4 PENDING items (F1 clamp, F4 style-confound probe, F2 prompt rewrite gate, F5 prevalence audit), 1 LOCKED (trivial_baseline), 1 CLOSED (defense_wins findings). All conditions and metric formula stay locked.

Gate 1 APPROVED with 13 decisions captured. Overrides from default: D10=3 reps (was 2), D11=include multi-file task, D4=30 pilot samples (was 10), D7=42 outputs broader probe (was 9). Estimated total cost ~-16 vs baseline .50.

Phase A complete: F1 clamp applied (drop, not clip; with structured OOR log). PoC re-run: python_coder_agent CQS-craft 0.627->0.805 (+0.18, corrected upward). OOR=0 this run (transient bug; clamp defensively in place). Both rich preambles now > none, directionally consistent with hypothesis.

User approved 11-dim algorithmic-code rubric replacing python-coder S3+ checklist. New dims: data_structure_choice, algorithm_correctness, error_handling_inconsistency, api_ergonomics, abstraction_miscalibration, code_organization, type_hint_gap, edge_case_gap, concurrency_safety (N/A-able), example_quality (N/A-able), documentation_appropriateness. All severity-coded 0-5 (higher=worse). Pre-reg amendment under SPEC §7 drift event.

meta.trigger: Phase D prevalence FAIL: 0/11 old dims active on algorithmic LLM code

detail: SPEC_V2.md amended: §6.2 task count 8->7 (drop modeflag_sort, A2), §6.3 pool 7->10 reasoning-stratified (A3+A4), §6.4 rubric redesigned 14->11 algorithmic-code dims (A1), §6.5 references new rubric, §12 Amendment Log added with A1-A4 entries.

HYPOTHESIS.md amended: added Cycle 2 Re-revised (ACTIVE) section locking outcome-question framing, reasoning-inclusive pool, redesigned rubric, stratified primary criterion (sig in at least one of {non-reasoning, reasoning, pooled}), per-dim threshold adjusted 4/11 -> 3/9 to preserve fraction. Prior Revised demoted to SUPERSEDED.

Built reprobe_phase_c_d2.py: 36 gens (3 reasoning models × 2 preambles × 3 tasks × 2 reps), each gen judged 3 ways (Phase C unanchored, Phase C anchored, Phase D2 11-dim rubric). Raw httpx so reasoning param + provider field round-trip. Gates: Phase C trigger |pooled Δ|>0.5; Phase D2 pass ≥3 of 9 always-on dims at ≥10% non-zero.

Phase C PASS (keep_unanchored, |Δ|=0.31 < 0.5). Phase D2 FAIL at judge layer not rubric layer (gpt-4o-mini single judge saturates 7/9 always-on dims at sev=0 with positive-toned rationales; only error_handling 43.8% and edge_case 43.8% surface). User chose multi-judge panel + anchor directive recovery.

Phase D2 PASS at strict gate (9/9 always-on dims at panel mean ≥1.0 on ≥10% samples). Multi-judge panel (gpt-4o-mini + deepseek-v3.2 + mistral-small) + calibration anchor surfaces variation gpt-4o-mini alone missed. Per-judge audit shows gpt-4o-mini partial saturation on algorithm_correctness (88% zero) but deepseek (21% zero, mean 1.55) and mistral (28% zero, mean 0.75) recover it in panel mean. Highest-signal dims: error_handling_inconsistency (mean 1.56, 100% non-zero) and edge_case_gap (mean 1.98, 100%).

SPEC_V2.md §12 Amendment A5 added: rubric scoring uses 3-judge cross-judge panel (non-reasoning tier) + calibration anchor directive in judge prompt. v1 self-judge-exclusion rule preserved. Documents recovery from Phase D2 single-judge saturation.

User caught 3-judge panel as a v1 regression. Locked: JUDGE_MODELS=ALL_MODELS (full 10-judge cross-judge matrix, v1-equivalent). Reasoning-tier judges run with reasoning:{exclude:true} (judging is structured task; subject-side reasoning is the variable under test, not judge-side). Self-judge exclusion preserved. SPEC A5 amended to match. Cost target ~ total vs ~ with reasoning on judges.

D10 (3 reps) re-resolved → 2 reps. With 10-model pool, n_per_condition = 10 × 7 × 2 = 140 raw / ~105 post-attrition, clearing §7 power floor of 100 with margin. The original D10=3 was sized for 7 models. 10 models capture more between-model variance (the external-validity axis); reps mainly capture within-cell residual variance for mixed-effects, which R=2 supplies. Cost: ~ saved (~ vs ~).

Built preamble_quality_v2_main.py: 10 subjects × 9 preambles × 7 tasks × 2 reps = 1260 gens; full cross-judge matrix (10 judges, self-exclusion, reasoning judges with reasoning:{exclude:true}); calibrated rubric judge + unanchored idiom/comment judge; static analysis diagnostic panel (radon+pylint+flake8 cog); incremental JSONL persistence + --resume; --slice flag for smoke test. CQS-craft = 0.45·idiom + 0.45·comment + 0.10·(1 - mean_rubric_sev/5).

Smoke test (2 models × 2 preambles × 1 task × 1 rep) passed: 4/4 gens extracted, 74/80 judges parsed (92.5%), 4/4 static analyses, 4/4 CQS-craft scores. Directional sanity: python_coder_agent 0.880 > none 0.832 matches v1 pattern. Cost /bin/zsh.116 → main run extrapolation -70.

Main run COMPLETE. 1215/1260 gens extracted (96.4%). 22028/24300 judges parsed (90.7%). 1215/1215 CQS-craft scored. Cost .02 (well under  budget). HYPOTHESIS SUPPORTED: KW p=9.24e-18 pooled, 1.76e-08 reasoning, 2.25e-12 non-reasoning. 7 of 9 always-on rubric dims preamble-significant (criterion was ≥3). Diagnostic null reproduces: 8 of 9 static metrics flat across preambles (pylint_conventions sole exception at p=0.012).

Wrote MIXED_EFFECTS.md and WEIGHT_SENSITIVITY.md. Mixed-effects pooled: long_directive β=+0.036 p=0.004; real_agent +0.024 p=0.057; python_coder_agent +0.024 p=0.058; negative_control -0.056 p=8e-6; trivial -0.237 p=2e-74. Task variance dominates model variance in all strata. Weight sensitivity: all 7 schemes preamble-significant at p<=2.4e-10.

Wrote CONCLUSIONS.md (12 sections, headline hypothesis SUPPORTED at p=9.2e-18; 7 of 9 rubric dims sig; mechanism cleanly confirmed) and REPORT_ADDENDUM.md (5 amendments A1-A5, pre-flight phase outcomes, cost breakdown). All §9 acceptance criteria met except v1-comparison sensitivity (covered in CONCLUSIONS §Comparison). Investigation complete.

Preamble Quality v2 investigation complete. Headline: hypothesis SUPPORTED at much higher confidence than v1. Total spend ~. Total time ~100 min. All §9 acceptance criteria met. Mechanism finding: preambles move alignment-dependent craft (7 of 9 rubric dims) but not pretraining-dependent capability (algorithm_correctness + data_structure_choice null, as predicted).

User caught omission: original mixed-effects had no reasoning indicator. Refit M0 (preamble only), M1 (+ tier main effect), M2 (preamble × tier interaction). Findings: tier main effect β=+0.087 p=0.117 marginal; preamble × tier interaction LRT χ²(8)=14.8 p=0.063 marginal; only trivial_baseline × reasoning interaction sig (p=0.049). Preamble effects statistically homogeneous across tiers for 8 main conditions. CONCLUSIONS.md and MIXED_EFFECTS.md updated; tier underpowered (3v7 imbalance) noted in limitations.

Wrote root README.md summarizing both experiments with v2 as headline. 5 takeaways for practitioners; minimal methodology section pointing to CONCLUSIONS.md, SPEC_V2.md, REPORT_ADDENDUM.md, MIXED_EFFECTS.md, WEIGHT_SENSITIVITY.md for details. Full M2 model spec recap. Repo layout map + reproducibility commands.

Generated 5 figures via ferrum-viz: fig1 headline CQS bar with bootstrap CIs (category-color-coded), fig2 per-dim severity heatmap (11 dims x 9 preambles), fig3 mechanism split (-log10(p) bar showing craft vs capability vs static), fig4 tier comparison (side-by-side panels showing same-shape-different-ceiling), fig5 task-category panel. Embedded fig1/fig2/fig3/fig4 in root README.md. SVG + PNG pairs in experiment_v2_results/figures/.

Switched figures.py from ferrum-viz to matplotlib+seaborn for finer label control. All 5 figures regenerated: value annotations on bars, y-axis zoomed to meaningful range (0.40-0.92 not 0-1), two-line preamble labels with no eliding, sample counts in subplot titles, dashed α=0.05 reference line on fig3, color-coded legends. Subscript glyph issue patched (Arial lacks subscripts). SVG+PNG pairs regenerated in figures/. PEP 723 deps: polars, numpy, scipy, matplotlib, seaborn.

3 confound probes run on task_expr_parser (n=10 each, full 10-judge panel, .04). Probe A nonrubric_expert: -0.155 vs none p=0.0001 (rules out judge-priming-only and generic-expert-priming). Probe B bare_rubric: +0.015 vs none p=0.50 (recovers 70% of long_directive lift; naming the rubric items does most of the work). Probe C antirubric_expert: -0.154 vs none p=0.0001 (mirrors probe A). Refined mechanism: attention-allocation — preambles direct model's craft-attention to enumerated dims; rubric measures enumerated dims; overlap determines lift. CQS-craft is real and rubric-dependent.

Updated remaining docs with confound probe findings. HYPOTHESIS.md (post-hoc mechanism refinement note in active Cycle 2 Re-revised section). REPORT_ADDENDUM.md (new Post-main-run section documenting the three probes and their methodological lesson). v1 RELATED_WORK.md (footnote pointing to v2 probes that refined the alignment-vs-pretraining framing inherited from PRISM).

User flagged ambiguous language in confound writeup ('judges reward expert-toned preambles'). Confirmed methodologically: judges were BLIND to preambles throughout (judge user msg = code only; system prompt = rubric+anchor; code refs in main + probes). Re-framed H-judge-priming explicitly as a code-level effect (model produces different surface markers under different preambles; blind judges detect them) NOT a leaked-information effect. Added methodology note to CONCLUSIONS.md and root README.
